project_type: Vite + React + TanStack Router SPA (frontend) + FastAPI + SQLAlchemy (backend in /backend)
build_system: Vite 5 (npm run build); backend runs via uvicorn. No monorepo tooling — frontend and backend are independent.
test_framework: No automated test framework found. Verification is by build (npm run build) and manual inspection.
test_command: npm run build (zero TypeScript errors = passing)
verification_instructions: 1. cd to workspace root. 2. Run `npm run build` — must complete with 0 errors. 3. For backend changes, verify Python syntax with `python -m py_compile backend/app/routers/admin.py` etc.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Backend uses SQLite in dev (SQLAlchemy). VITE_API_URL must be set for API features; without it the store works offline-first. Do NOT restart any running dev server.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: All API calls via src/lib/api.ts when VITE_API_URL set. Storefront must work offline-first (no VITE_API_URL = graceful empty states, not errors). Zero hardcoded fallback content for homepage sections. No force-push/rebase on published commits.
key_patterns: Frontend: React Query hooks in src/lib/api.ts (liveQuery helper pattern). All hooks guard with `enabled: apiEnabled`. Backend: generic CRUD via PUT /api/v1/admin/r/{name}/{id}; singletons via /admin/settings/{name}; custom routes for orders/stats. Admin panel: single-file vanilla JS SPA in backend/app/admin_panel/index.html. Models all exist in backend/app/models.py — do not recreate.
directory_structure:
/ — workspace root (Vite SPA)
/src/routes/ — TanStack file-based routes (index.tsx=homepage, track.tsx=order tracking)
/src/components/veloura/ — all storefront UI (commerce.tsx=1496 lines, customer-confidence.tsx, shopping-ui.tsx, etc.)
/src/lib/ — api.ts (React Query hooks), veloura-data.ts (static fallback data), veloura-store.tsx (cart/order context), live-catalog.tsx (product sync)
/backend/app/ — FastAPI app: main.py, models.py, routers/{admin,public,orders,auth,tracking}.py, admin_panel/index.html
